tpms.when: 2009 (low tire pressure warning light, no driver reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire information placard on the driver's door jamb, checking them before driving or after the car has sat for a few hours.
If you are filling the tires in a garage that is warmer than outside, add about 1 psi for every 10°F of difference so they are not low once outside.
Turn the ignition on and drive normally. With the pressures corrected, the low tire pressure light should go out by itself; there is no button to press.
If the light comes back on soon after filling, one tire is probably leaking or flat: stop somewhere safe and check it.
At high altitude the light can stay on even at the placard pressure; adding a little air above the placard figure clears it.
tpms.note: If the light blinks for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix; have a dealer check it. The light can also go out on its own after a long or hot drive, so check the pressures anyway.

notes: The SX4 has no driver reset for the tire pressure light: it goes out once the tires are at the right pressure. After fitting the spare or new wheels, the owner's manual section on replacing tires and wheels explains how to get the system working normally again.
